paragraphs.text: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show unto his servants, [even] the things which must shortly come to pass: and he sent and signified [it] by his angel unto his servant John;
paragraphs.original: Ἀποκάλυψις Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἣν ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεὸς δεῖξαι τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ, ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι ἐν τάχει, καὶ ἐσήμανεν ἀποστείλας διὰ τοῦ ἀγγέλου αὐτοῦ τῷ δούλῳ αὐτοῦ Ἰωάννῃ,
paragraphs.translit: Apokalypsis Iēsou Christou, hēn edōken autō ho theos deixai tois doulois autou, ha dei genesthai en tachei, kai esēmanen aposteilas dia tou angelou autou tō doulō autou Iōannē,

paragraphs.text: who bare witness of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, [even] of all things that he saw.
paragraphs.original: ὃς ἐμαρτύρησεν τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὅσα εἶδεν.
paragraphs.translit: hos emartyrēsen ton logon tou theou kai tēn martyrian Iēsou Christou, hosa eiden.

paragraphs.text: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written therein: for the time is at hand.
paragraphs.original: μακάριος ὁ ἀναγινώσκων καὶ οἱ ἀκούοντες τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας καὶ τηροῦντες τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ γεγραμμένα, ὁ γὰρ καιρὸς ἐγγύς.
paragraphs.translit: makarios ho anaginōskōn kai hoi akouontes tous logous tēs prophēteias kai tērountes ta en autē gegrammena, ho gar kairos engys.

paragraphs.text: John to the seven churches that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from him who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits that are before his throne;
paragraphs.original: Ἰωάννης ταῖς ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαις ταῖς ἐν τῇ Ἀσίᾳ· χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἑπτὰ πνευμάτων ἃ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: Iōannēs tais hepta ekklēsiais tais en tē Asia· charis hymin kai eirēnē apo ho ōn kai ho ēn kai ho erchomenos, kai apo tōn hepta pneumatōn ha enōpion tou thronou autou,

paragraphs.text: and from Jesus Christ, [who is] the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loveth us, and loosed us from our sins by his blood;
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀπὸ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ μάρτυς ὁ πιστός, ὁ πρωτότοκος τῶν νεκρῶν καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν βασιλέων τῆς γῆς. Τῷ ἀγαπῶντι ἡμᾶς καὶ λύσαντι ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ αἵματι αὐτοῦ—
paragraphs.translit: kai apo Iēsou Christou, ho martys ho pistos, ho prōtotokos tōn nekrōn kai ho archōn tōn basileōn tēs gēs. Tō agapōnti hēmas kai lysanti hēmas ek tōn hamartiōn hēmōn en tō haimati autou—

paragraphs.text: and he made us [to be] a kingdom, [to be] priests unto his God and Father; to him [be] the glory and the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἡμᾶς βασιλείαν, ἱερεῖς τῷ θεῷ καὶ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ— αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.
paragraphs.translit: kai epoiēsen hēmas basileian, hiereis tō theō kai patri autou— autō hē doxa kai to kratos eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn· amēn.

paragraphs.text: Behold, he cometh with the clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they that pierced him; and all the tribes of the earth shall mourn over him. Even so, Amen.
paragraphs.original: Ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται μετὰ τῶν νεφελῶν, καὶ ὄψεται αὐτὸν πᾶς ὀφθαλμὸς καὶ οἵτινες αὐτὸν ἐξεκέντησαν, καὶ κόψονται ἐπʼ αὐτὸν πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς. ναί, ἀμήν.
paragraphs.translit: Idou erchetai meta tōn nephelōn, kai opsetai auton pas ophthalmos kai hoitines auton exekentēsan, kai kopsontai epʼ auton pasai hai phylai tēs gēs. nai, amēn.

paragraphs.text: I am the Alpha and the Omega, saith the Lord God, who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.
paragraphs.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ, λέγει κύριος, ὁ θεός, ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος, ὁ παντοκράτωρ.
paragraphs.translit: Egō eimi to Alpha kai to Ō, legei kyrios, ho theos, ho ōn kai ho ēn kai ho erchomenos, ho pantokratōr.

paragraphs.text: I John, your brother and partaker with you in tribulation and kingdom and patience [which are] in Jesus, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
paragraphs.original: Ἐγὼ Ἰωάννης, ὁ ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν καὶ συγκοινωνὸς ἐν τῇ θλίψει καὶ βασιλείᾳ καὶ ὑπομονῇ ἐν Ἰησοῦ, ἐγενόμην ἐν τῇ νήσῳ τῇ καλουμένῃ Πάτμῳ διὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Egō Iōannēs, ho adelphos hymōn kai synkoinōnos en tē thlipsei kai basileia kai hypomonē en Iēsou, egenomēn en tē nēsō tē kaloumenē Patmō dia ton logon tou theou kai tēn martyrian Iēsou.

paragraphs.text: I was in the Spirit on the Lord`s day, and I heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet
paragraphs.original: ἐγενόμην ἐν πνεύματι ἐν τῇ κυριακῇ ἡμέρᾳ, καὶ ἤκουσα ὀπίσω μου φωνὴν μεγάλην ὡς σάλπιγγος
paragraphs.translit: egenomēn en pneumati en tē kyriakē hēmera, kai ēkousa opisō mou phōnēn megalēn hōs salpingos

paragraphs.text: saying, What thou seest, write in a book and send [it] to the seven churches: unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamum, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
paragraphs.original: λεγούσης· Ὃ βλέπεις γράψον εἰς βιβλίον καὶ πέμψον ταῖς ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαις, εἰς Ἔφεσον καὶ εἰς Σμύρναν καὶ εἰς Πέργαμον καὶ εἰς Θυάτειρα καὶ εἰς Σάρδεις καὶ εἰς Φιλαδέλφειαν καὶ εἰς Λαοδίκειαν.
paragraphs.translit: legousēs· Ho blepeis grapson eis biblion kai pempson tais hepta ekklēsiais, eis Epheson kai eis Smyrnan kai eis Pergamon kai eis Thyateira kai eis Sardeis kai eis Philadelpheian kai eis Laodikeian.

paragraphs.text: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And having turned I saw seven golden candlesticks;
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἐπέστρεψα βλέπειν τὴν φωνὴν ἥτις ἐλάλει μετʼ ἐμοῦ· καὶ ἐπιστρέψας εἶδον ἑπτὰ λυχνίας χρυσᾶς,
paragraphs.translit: Kai epestrepsa blepein tēn phōnēn hētis elalei metʼ emou· kai epistrepsas eidon hepta lychnias chrysas,

paragraphs.text: and in the midst of the candlesticks one like unto a son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about at the breasts with a golden girdle.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τῶν λυχνιῶν ὅμοιον υἱὸν ἀνθρώπου, ἐνδεδυμένον ποδήρη καὶ περιεζωσμένον πρὸς τοῖς μαστοῖς ζώνην χρυσᾶν·
paragraphs.translit: kai en mesō tōn lychniōn homoion hyion anthrōpou, endedymenon podērē kai periezōsmenon pros tois mastois zōnēn chrysan·

paragraphs.text: And his head and his hair were white as white wool, [white] as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
paragraphs.original: ἡ δὲ κεφαλὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ τρίχες λευκαὶ ὡς ἔριον λευκόν, ὡς χιών, καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ ὡς φλὸξ πυρός,
paragraphs.translit: hē de kephalē autou kai hai triches leukai hōs erion leukon, hōs chiōn, kai hoi ophthalmoi autou hōs phlox pyros,

paragraphs.text: and his feet like unto burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace; and his voice as the voice of many waters.
paragraphs.original: καὶ οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ ὅμοιοι χαλκολιβάνῳ, ὡς ἐν καμίνῳ πεπυρωμένης, καὶ ἡ φωνὴ αὐτοῦ ὡς φωνὴ ὑδάτων πολλῶν,
paragraphs.translit: kai hoi podes autou homoioi chalkolibanō, hōs en kaminō pepyrōmenēs, kai hē phōnē autou hōs phōnē hydatōn pollōn,

paragraphs.text: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἔχων ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ ἀστέρας ἑπτά, καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ ῥομφαία δίστομος ὀξεῖα ἐκπορευομένη, καὶ ἡ ὄψις αὐτοῦ ὡς ὁ ἥλιος φαίνει ἐν τῇ δυνάμει αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai echōn en tē dexia cheiri autou asteras hepta, kai ek tou stomatos autou rhomphaia distomos oxeia ekporeuomenē, kai hē opsis autou hōs ho hēlios phainei en tē dynamei autou.

paragraphs.text: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as one dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying, Fear not; I am the first and the last,
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ὅτε εἶδον αὐτόν, ἔπεσα πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ ὡς νεκρός· καὶ ἔθηκεν τὴν δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ ἐπʼ ἐμὲ λέγων· Μὴ φοβοῦ· ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος,
paragraphs.translit: Kai hote eidon auton, epesa pros tous podas autou hōs nekros· kai ethēken tēn dexian autou epʼ eme legōn· Mē phobou· egō eimi ho prōtos kai ho eschatos,

paragraphs.text: and the Living one; and I was dead, and behold, I am alive for evermore, and I have the keys of death and of Hades.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὁ ζῶν— καὶ ἐγενόμην νεκρὸς καὶ ἰδοὺ ζῶν εἰμι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων— καὶ ἔχω τὰς κλεῖς τοῦ θανάτου καὶ τοῦ ᾅδου.
paragraphs.translit: kai ho zōn— kai egenomēn nekros kai idou zōn eimi eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn— kai echō tas kleis tou thanatou kai tou hadou.

paragraphs.text: Write therefore the things which thou sawest, and the things which are, and the things which shall come to pass hereafter;
paragraphs.original: γράψον οὖν ἃ εἶδες καὶ ἃ εἰσὶν καὶ ἃ μέλλει γίνεσθαι μετὰ ταῦτα.
paragraphs.translit: grapson oun ha eides kai ha eisin kai ha mellei ginesthai meta tauta.

paragraphs.text: the mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks are seven churches.
paragraphs.original: τὸ μυστήριον τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀστέρων οὓς εἶδες ἐπὶ τῆς δεξιᾶς μου, καὶ τὰς ἑπτὰ λυχνίας τὰς χρυσᾶς· οἱ ἑπτὰ ἀστέρες ἄγγελοι τῶν ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησιῶν εἰσίν, καὶ αἱ λυχνίαι αἱ ἑπτὰ ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαι εἰσίν.
paragraphs.translit: to mystērion tōn hepta asterōn hous eides epi tēs dexias mou, kai tas hepta lychnias tas chrysas· hoi hepta asteres angeloi tōn hepta ekklēsiōn eisin, kai hai lychniai hai hepta hepta ekklēsiai eisin.
